verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time, so the opt-out exists. The evidence does not show an org-level or admin control an engineering lead could apply on behalf of a team, nor whether both code and prompts are covered. Community doubt about whether enterprise code is excluded from training is general skepticism, not a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: an organization/enterprise-wide training opt-out or policy setting, explicit coverage of both code and prompts, and independent corroboration.
